pages.text: $(thing)JustARod$() is a toNeko add-on themed around $(#FF69B4)end rods$().$(br2)Here, you can:$(li)Collect $(#FF69B4)all kinds of end rods$(li)Experience the $(#FF69B4)medical system$() — vaccines, drugs and surgery$(li)Use toys to $(#FF69B4)bond with your neko$(li)Breed babies and explore the mysteries of $(#FF69B4)genetics$(br2)$(#FFB6C1)Just a rod.
